hero.title: Timeless Fashion, Crafted for Everyday Life
hero.description: We believe great style should be effortless, premium, and accessible. Every collection is carefully curated with quality, comfort, and modern design in mind.

story.title: Inspired by Simplicity
story.description: Founded with a passion for timeless fashion, our mission is to create collections that blend contemporary aesthetics with exceptional craftsmanship. We focus on premium materials, attention to detail, and pieces that become wardrobe essentials.

values.title: What We Stand For
values.description: Our values guide everything we create.

quality.title: Premium Quality
quality.description: Carefully selected materials and meticulous craftsmanship ensure every product lasts.

design.title: Modern Design
design.description: Minimal, elegant, and versatile styles made for everyday wear.

sustainability.title: Responsible Future
sustainability.description: We continuously work toward more sustainable materials and ethical production.

cta.title: Discover Our Collection
cta.description: Explore our latest arrivals and timeless essentials designed for every season.

hero.title: We'd Love to Hear From You
hero.description: Whether you have a question about an order, our products, or simply want to say hello, we're here to help.

info.title: Get in Touch

hero.title: Build the Future With Us
hero.description: Join a passionate team creating exceptional shopping experiences through thoughtful design, innovation, and technology.

why.title: Why Join Us
why.description: We believe great people build great products. That's why we invest in our team.

growth.title: Career Growth
growth.description: Learn, improve your skills, and grow with exciting challenges.

team.title: Collaborative Culture
team.description: Work alongside talented people in an open and supportive environment.

balance.title: Work-Life Balance
balance.description: Flexible work arrangements that help you stay productive and healthy.

positions.title: Open Positions
positions.description: We're always looking for talented individuals to join our team.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: Find answers to the questions we receive most often. If you still need help, feel free to contact our support team.

shipping.question: How long does shipping take?
shipping.answer: Standard shipping usually takes 3–7 business days depending on your location.

returns.question: Can I return my order?
returns.answer: Yes. You can return eligible items within 30 days of receiving your order.

payment.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
payment.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

tracking.question: How can I track my order?
tracking.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number and shipping updates.

international.question: Do you ship internationally?
international.answer: Yes, we ship to many countries around the world. Shipping costs are calculated during checkout.

support.question: How do I contact customer support?
support.answer: You can reach us through our contact page or email our support team anytime.

hero.title: Shipping & Delivery
hero.description: Everything you need to know about how we process, ship, and deliver your orders.

processing.title: Order Processing
processing.description: Orders are processed within 1–2 business days. During holidays or promotional periods, processing may take slightly longer.

delivery.title: Delivery Times
delivery.description: Standard shipping typically arrives within 3–7 business days. Express shipping options are available during checkout for eligible locations.

tracking.title: Order Tracking
tracking.description: Once your order has been shipped, you'll receive a confirmation email containing your tracking number and shipping updates.

international.title: International Shipping
international.description: We ship to many countries worldwide. Shipping costs and estimated delivery times are calculated automatically during checkout.

returns.title: Shipping Issues
returns.description: If your order is delayed, damaged, or lost in transit, please contact our customer support team and we'll resolve the issue as quickly as possible.

hero.title: Returns & Refunds
hero.description: We want you to shop with confidence. Learn everything about our return, exchange, and refund policies.

policy.title: Return Policy
policy.description: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Products must be unused, in their original condition, and include all original packaging.

eligibility.title: Return Eligibility
eligibility.description: Items that have been worn, damaged, altered, or purchased as final sale are not eligible for returns unless they arrived defective.

process.title: How to Start a Return
process.description: Contact our support team with your order number. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping label when applicable.

refunds.title: Refund Process
refunds.description: Once we receive and inspect your returned item, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.description: Need a different size or color? Contact us as soon as possible, and we'll help arrange an exchange based on product availability.
